attributes.proposal_name: Digital Dancer ID – Empowering the Global Dance Community on the Cardano Blockchain 💃
attributes.key_dependencies:
**Key Operational and Strategic Dependencies**

The successful execution of the proposal depends on a few key operational and strategic dependencies that affect project pacing, delivery, and continuity:

**1. Milestone-Based Funding Disbursement**  
The project is structured around incremental milestones, each unlocking development and outreach stages. Timely and complete disbursement of funding at each milestone is essential to maintain development velocity, staffing, and partner engagement.

**2. Company Incorporation and Legal Setup**  
To handle funding, contracts, federation agreements, and long-term sustainability, the team will formally register a new legal entity. This process must be completed early in Milestone 1 to ensure financial and operational transparency.

**3. Hiring and Team Expansion**  
Although the lead developer and coordinator are available from the start, onboarding additional full-time developers and support staff is crucial to delivering Milestone 2 and beyond. Timely hiring is required to meet the planned 12-month delivery timeline.

**4. Smart Contract Audit Partner Availability**  
A third-party audit of our identity anchoring smart contracts is included in the roadmap and budget. Securing a qualified Cardano audit partner within the appropriate delivery window is necessary to meet both technical standards and trust assurances expected by DReps and the wider Cardano ecosystem.

**5. Federation Cooperation and Early Adoption**  
Engagement from key national and international dance federations/organizations will be essential during Milestones 2 and 3. While initial federation relationships are already in place, continued alignment, testing, and onboarding support will be needed to validate and scale the platform.
attributes.maintain_and_support:
**Post-Launch Maintenance and Support**  
After the initial rollout, the project will be maintained by the in-house team — ensuring deep continuity, domain knowledge, and the ability to iterate based on real user feedback.

**Sustainability Through Revenue**  
The post-launch maintenance phase will be financially supported by revenue from:

- Basic membership fees, as well as premium features and user subscriptions for enhanced profiles, analytics, and visibility  
- Commission-based revenue from handling competition entry fees on behalf of event organizers  
- Federation subscriptions, backend tools, and data access fees  
- Grant or ecosystem collaboration funding for Cardano integrations  

These revenue streams are expected to support the core team, hosting costs, and expansion opportunities beyond the first year.
attributes.proposal_description:
> Digital Dancer ID is a decentralized identity and community platform for the global ballroom dance ecosystem — serving dancers, coaches, adjudicators, event organizers, and federations. Each user receives a unique, verifiable digital identity that consolidates their roles, credentials, and achievements across federations, competitions, and services. This identity allows users to log in to affiliated platforms, share verified status, and manage a customizable public profile.
> The platform replaces outdated paper-based systems with a transparent, blockchain-secured environment. Federation-issued rankings, results, and certifications will be anchored on the Cardano blockchain for authenticity, while extended profile content like bios and documents will be stored off-chain via IPFS. A built-in QR code system enables instant identity and eligibility checks at competitions, streamlining on-site operations and reducing fraud.
> To promote blockchain utility, the platform will accept ₳ (ADA) as payment method, alongside traditional options, for event entries, subscriptions, and verification tools. With a roadmap rooted in real-world use, deep ties to the dance community, and a strong focus on adoption, this project introduces Cardano technology into a vibrant and largely unexposed cultural sector ready for innovation.
> (More in-depth proposal description can be found inside the document listed in the Supporting links section below)
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
**Project Structure & Milestones**

The project is structured around four incremental milestones, each delivering tangible, working components of the Dancer Digital ID platform. Upon completion of the 12-month development cycle, the Cardano and dance communities will receive a fully operational identity and federation management system built on Cardano, along with active user adoption through partnered federations and global events.

---

**Deliverables by Milestone:**

**Milestone 1: OAuth Provider Launch (2 months)**  
- Dancer ID website with registration and login system  
- Functional OAuth provider integrated into at least one live dance-related service  
- Brand identity package and marketing materials  
- Infrastructure deployed with secure API layer  

   ✔️ *Definition of Done:*  
   System publicly available for login  
   Cardano brand support visibly acknowledged

---

**Milestone 2: Core Platform Delivery (5 months)**  
- User profiles system  
- Web dashboard + mobile app MVP (iOS/Android)  
- QR-based Dancer ID identity system  
- On-chain identity & smart contracts deployed on Cardano (with audit)  
- ₳ (ADA) payments enabled  

   ✔️ *Definition of Done:*  
   Core system usable by dancers and federations  
   On-chain identity and payment systems verified  
   Smart contract audit completed

---

**Milestone 3: Marketing & Community Activation (3 months)**  
- Sponsored competitions and dance events with on-site physical presence  
  (e.g. branded booth, Cardano-branded marketing and educational materials)  
- Social media presence  
- Federations onboarding and outreach campaigns  
- Development of additional features and bug fixing based on early adopter feedback  

   ✔️ *Definition of Done:*  
   At least 2 federations onboarded  
   At least 2 physical events attended with branded presence and working Dancer ID system

---

**Milestone 4: Global Rollout & Finalization (2 months)**  
- Final features released (monetization tools, feedback-based additions)  
- Legal and compliance layer completed (ToS, GDPR handling)  
- Launch materials, support channels, and user documentation delivered  

   ✔️ *Definition of Done:*  
   Platform operating with real users, federations, and revenue mechanisms in place

---

**What the Cardano Community Receives:**  
- A real-world, high-visibility use case of blockchain identity in a global cultural sector  
- A user-facing app that brings ADA payments into everyday use  
- Verified on-chain records for thousands of dancers, tied to meaningful credentials  
- Open collaboration potential with Cardano identity tools, wallets, and event platforms  
- Ongoing Cardano visibility through public events, federations, and cross-service integrations

attributes.problem_statement:
The global dance community — encompassing amateur dancers, elite professionals, and governing federations — continues to operate using fragmented and outdated systems. Identity verification, certification records, competition results, and membership data are still largely managed through paper-based “dance passports,” spreadsheets, emails, or disconnected databases maintained by individual organizations. These methods lack standardization, interoperability, and long-term trust.
Dancers often find themselves unable to prove their achievements or official status across borders or federations. They also lack a unified digital home — a place where they can build a public profile, showcase officially verified accomplishments and memberships, and connect with their community. There are some limited solutions narrowed to the members of a certain federation only.
This outdated infrastructure not only creates inefficiencies but also exposes the system to errors, possible manipulation, and data loss. In a world where dance is increasingly international and digital, the lack of a secure, interoperable, and verifiable identity layer is holding the entire ecosystem back.
attributes.proposal_benefit:
**Unique Verified Identity On The Blockchain:**
Digital Dancer ID* offers a transformative solution to the structural inefficiencies facing the global dance community. By providing each dancer and dance professional with a *unique, verifiable identity anchored on the Cardano blockchain*, the platform creates a tamper-proof, portable record of achievements, affiliations, and roles across multiple federations. 

**OAuth Provider:**
This identity can be used not only for recordkeeping but also for *logging* into external dance-related services through a secure *OAuth mechanism*— streamlining the experience for users and partners alike.

**₳ (ADA) Payments:**
By integrating Cardano’s native *ADA payments as an option*, the platform also introduces blockchain utility to the dance world, enabling secure transactions for event registrations, verification services, and premium features. 

**Cardano Ecosystem Expansion into the Dance World Niche and Liquidity Attraction:**
These touchpoints *introduce the Cardano ecosystem to thousands of dancers* and numerous federations and dance organizations worldwide, driving real-world adoption of decentralized identity in a dynamic and culturally rich niche — one that has, until now, remained *unexposed to blockchain technology.*
attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap: Digital Dancer ID aligns with Cardano’s broader mission of increasing global recognition and demonstrating real-world utility. By placing Cardano’s blockchain technology at the heart of a platform used by dancers, federations, and event organizers worldwide, the project brings decentralization, transparency, and reliability into a culturally rich yet technologically underserved space. This proposal directly supports Cardano’s goal of expanding mainstream public awareness by embedding blockchain into the daily operations of a visible, international, and highly engaged creative community.
